mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tap_events (id, branch_id, tag_id, stage, outcome, reason, counter, counter_gap, customer_id, tap_token_id, stamp_id, ip, browser_id_hash, user_agent_hash, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{branchId}, #{tagId}, #{stage}, #{outcome}, #{reason}, #{counter}, #{counterGap}, #{customerId}, #{tapTokenId}, #{stampId}, CAST(#{ip} AS inet), #{browserIdHash}, #{userAgentHash}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT reason FROM tap_events WHERE tap_token_id = #{tapTokenId} AND customer_id = #{customerId} AND stage = 'CLAIM' AND outcome = 'REJECTED' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM tap_events WHERE browser_id_hash = #{browserIdHash} AND stage = 'CLAIM' AND outcome = 'ACCEPTED' AND created_at > #{since}
